findings.title: CTA button focus states missing
findings.description: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-violet-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none to both CTA buttons at lines 195-206 in page.tsx. This is a WCAG 2.4.7 Level AA violation.

findings.title: 3D cards have cursor-pointer but no keyboard accessibility
findings.description: Either remove cursor-pointer from Hero3DCreatorCard.tsx line 43 if cards are purely decorative, or wrap them in semantic interactive elements if they should be clickable. The whileHover effect combined with pointer cursor creates false affordance.

findings.title: Gradient text contrast needs real-device verification
findings.description: The CSS changes use violet-300 (#c4b5fd) and cyan-300 (#67e8f9) on mobile, which should provide adequate contrast, but OLED screens with true black backgrounds can behave unexpectedly. Test on actual iPhone/Android device before final approval to confirm readability.
